reports.title: TriNet Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results and Now Expects to Deliver Earnings at the Top End of Earnings per Share Guidance Range

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Guidance
section: In addition to announcing our third quarter 2026 results, we are reaffirming our full-year 2026 guidance and expect to be at the high end of our earnings per diluted share range. Non-GAAP financial measures are reconciled later in this release.

(dollars in millions, except for per share amounts) | Low | High
Total Revenues | 4,750 | 4,900
Professional Service Revenues | 647 | 663
Insurance Cost Ratio | 89.5 | 88.5
Adjusted EBITDA Margin | 8.5 | 9.0
Diluted net income per share of common stock | 2.85 | 3.35
Adjusted Net Income per share - diluted | 4.50 | 5.10
